summary: Hageman voted to support Israel in November 2023, for military aid to Israel in February 2024, and for Israel funding over Ukraine in April 2024, calling Israel 'our ally.' In February 2024 she told Free Palestine protesters at the Wyoming Capitol to 'go join the terrorists,' defending Israel's military action. Her vote against the IHRA-based Antisemitism Awareness Act in May 2024 was explained by her as a First Amendment objection, not a statement on Israel policy.
